title: Advanced Discourse Markers
completion_message: ¡Extraordinario! Los Discourse Markers avanzados son el pegamento que convierte oraciones simples en argumentos sólidos y bien articulados. Usarlos correctamente es la marca de un escritor y orador ejecutivo de primer nivel.

stages.title: Conectores y Marcadores del Discurso Avanzados

parts.visual:
Los Discourse Markers conectan ideas y dan cohesión al discurso formal. En nivel C1 reemplazamos conectores básicos (also, but, so) por alternativas sofisticadas: 
- Furthermore / Moreover (Además / Es más): Agrega información de igual o mayor relevancia. 
Ej: The project is over budget. Furthermore, it is behind schedule. 
- Nevertheless / Nonetheless (Sin embargo / No obstante): Contraste o concesión, a pesar de todo. 
Ej: Sales are falling. Nevertheless, the board remains optimistic.
parts.audio: Discourse Markers connect ideas and give cohesion to formal writing. At the C1 level, we replace basic connectors like 'also', 'but', and 'so' with more sophisticated alternatives. 'Furthermore' or 'Moreover' mean 'in addition to' and are used to add information of equal or greater importance. For example: The project is over budget. Furthermore, it is behind schedule. 'Nevertheless' or 'Nonetheless' are used to show contrast or concession, meaning 'in spite of that'. For example: Sales are falling. Nevertheless, the board remains optimistic.

parts.visual:
Más conectores avanzados C1: 
- Notwithstanding (A pesar de / No obstante - muy formal, incluso legal). 
Ej: Notwithstanding the challenges, we delivered on time. 
- Consequently / Therefore (Por lo tanto / En consecuencia): Resultado o efecto. 
Ej: The budget was cut. Consequently, we had to reduce the team. 
- In so far as / Insofar as (En la medida en que): Para establecer límites o condiciones. 
Ej: This proposal is acceptable, in so far as it does not exceed our budget.
parts.audio: More advanced C1 connectors. 'Notwithstanding' means 'in spite of' and is very formal, often used in legal language. For example: Notwithstanding the challenges, we delivered on time. 'Consequently' or 'Therefore' indicate a result or effect. For example: The budget was cut. Consequently, we had to reduce the team. 'In so far as' or 'Insofar as' is used to establish limits or conditions, meaning 'to the extent that'. For example: This proposal is acceptable, in so far as it does not exceed our budget.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el Discourse Marker correcto según el contexto.

questions.question: The company is profitable. ____, it is expanding into new markets. (Añadir información importante - Además).
questions.explanation: Furthermore = además (agrega información relevante en el mismo sentido).

questions.question: The results were disappointing. ____, the team did not give up. (A pesar de eso / Contraste).
questions.explanation: Nevertheless = sin embargo, no obstante (introduce un contraste).

questions.question: ____ the criticism from investors, the CEO stood by her decision. (A pesar de - formal/legal).
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding = a pesar de (muy formal, precede a un sustantivo).

questions.question: The contract was broken. ____, we are entitled to compensation. (Por lo tanto).
questions.explanation: Consequently = en consecuencia, por lo tanto (causa-efecto).

questions.question: We will proceed with the acquisition, ____ it does not violate antitrust laws. (En la medida en que).
questions.explanation: In so far as = en la medida en que (establece una condición/límite).

questions.question: Revenue has doubled this year. ____, operating costs have decreased. (Además / Adicionalmente con más énfasis que Furthermore).
questions.explanation: Moreover = además (muy similar a Furthermore, ligeramente más enfático).

questions.question: I agree with your proposal. ____, I think we need to revise the timeline. (Sin embargo - contraste suave).
questions.explanation: However = sin embargo (contraste general, muy versátil).

questions.question: The market crashed. ____, many investors lost their savings. (Por consiguiente).
questions.explanation: As a result = como resultado (consecuencia directa).

questions.question: The report is accurate ____ it relies on data collected before March. (En la medida en que / Con la condición de que).
questions.explanation: In so far as (establece el límite de la validez de la afirmación).

questions.question: The company has suffered significant losses. ____, the board has decided to restructure. (Por lo tanto / En consecuencia).
The merger is complex. ____, it is a necessary step for the company's survival. (Sin embargo).
questions.explanation: Nonetheless = no obstante, sin embargo (igual que Nevertheless).

questions.question: The new policy is effective. ____, it has been well received by the staff. (Además - agrega otro punto positivo).
questions.explanation: Furthermore = además (agrega otro punto a favor).

questions.question: Costs rose by 30%. ____, the quality of the product improved significantly. (A pesar de eso).
questions.explanation: Nonetheless = no obstante (contraste con lo anterior).

questions.question: ____ the setbacks, the project was delivered on time. (A pesar de - seguido de sustantivo).
The software was poorly designed. ____, it was expensive to develop. (Además - agrega problema).
questions.explanation: Moreover = además (añade otro elemento negativo al argumento).

questions.question: The strategy failed. ____, the team learned valuable lessons. (Sin embargo - punto positivo).
questions.explanation: However = sin embargo (introduce el lado positivo).

questions.question: His qualifications are impressive. ____, his lack of experience is a concern. (Por otro lado / Sin embargo).
questions.explanation: Nevertheless = sin embargo (contrasta las buenas calificaciones con la falta de experiencia).

questions.question: The new machine is faster. ____, it consumes less energy. (Además).
The deal fell through. ____, we need a new plan. (Por consiguiente).
questions.explanation: Consequently = por lo tanto (efecto lógico del fallo).

questions.question: He is a brilliant analyst, ____ his reports are always accurate and insightful. (Dado que / Y de hecho).
questions.explanation: And indeed = y de hecho (refuerza y confirma la afirmación anterior).

questions.question: The project is late. ____, it is over budget. (Además con F)
Sales fell. ____, staff stayed positive. (Sin embargo con N)
____ the risks, we proceeded. (A pesar de - formal con N)
Costs rose. ____, we cut staff. (En consecuencia con C)
He's good, ____ he is expensive. (Sin embargo con H)
Revenue grew. ____, costs fell. (Además con M)
It failed. ____, we learned. (No obstante con N)
It is valid ____ it is legal. (En la medida en que - 4 palabras)
It crashed. ____, many lost money. (Como resultado - 3 palabras)
She's brilliant. It is ____ important. (De hecho - 2 palabras)

pairs.target: No obstante / A pesar de todo
